description: ConnectLinx is an AI command center for real estate agents, brokers, and teams. Connect your ConnectLinx account and run your business from chat: review and update your listings for rent and for sale across both residential and commercial, triage and reply to leads, manage showings, move deals through your pipeline, and stay on top of your CRM, calendar, and team. It shows you exactly what you see when you log in, no more and no less. Writes are scoped and safe (no delete tools, drafts stay drafts) and outbound email always asks you to confirm before sending. Strongest in the South Florida market with direct agent and landlord inventory.
